storyCards.headline: We Belong: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Pat Benatar's "We Belong" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "We Belong" is a song recorded by American rock singer Pat Benatar, released through Legacy Music Group on October 16, 1984, as the lead single from her fifth studio album, Tropico (1984).

The song was written by the songwriting duo of Eric Lowen and Dan Navarro.

It matched the success of "Love Is a Battlefield" on the Billboard Hot 100 singles chart in the United States, peaking at #5.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #5 on the Hot 100.
